items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: It was Vic's Grocery. Old man Vic and Tina and Tina had a brother.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, I lived in this vicinity all my days, all my days. Born and raised right here. You know where I was born at? Where? St. Philip and Preah, I just now remember now. Oh yeah. That on the corner is a big two story house. That's where I was born. Yeah, it's opposite Vic's Grocery. Yeah. It's a bar room. It was a bar room now.

Yeah. It was a bar room now. It was a bar room now. It was a bar room now. Yeah, yeah. It was a bar room. It was a bar room. Yeah. It was a bar room. Yeah. It was Vic's Grocery. Old man Vic and Tina and Tina had a brother. Yeah. And the old man used to go hunting every weekend. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
Boy, I tell you, there's so many, that's what I'm saying now. I can't think of all of that now, you know what I mean?
